title: CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT SERVICES, WHITEHORSE CADET TRAINING CENTRE WHITEHORSE
description: Advance Procurement Notice Construction Management SErvices, Whitehorse Cadet training Centre Whitehorse, Yukon  (with Security Requirements) Purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform contractors of an upcoming contract opportunity at Whitehorse, Yukon. The purpose of this APN is to allow contractors to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process, notably by initiating any necessary steps. This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested contractors to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable). Please note that this project will include Indigenous businesses participation component in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB). Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process. Description of the Project and Services The objective of this contract is to recapitalize both vertical and horizontal infrastructure at the Whitehorse Cadet Training Centre (WCTC) through a multi-year program. The existing WCTC site includes a diverse portfolio of facilities comprising 39 buildings with a total floor area of approximately 5,000 m². These facilities include barracks with associated ablution areas, classrooms, a combined kitchen/dining/administration building, a large storage warehouse, and various workshops and auxiliary support structures. The recapitalization program will encompass the renovation of existing buildings, as well as the demolition and reconstruction of selected facilities, to modernize and enhance the overall functionality of the site. Project delivery will be undertaken using a Construction Management (CM) contract, with an estimated total contract value of $50 million. The solicitation for this project is anticipated to be issued in Fall 2026, subject to project approval to proceed by the Department of National Defence (DND). The Government of Canada is committed to advancing reconciliation and fostering meaningful engagement with Indigenous Peoples. In support of these commitments, DND aims to create opportunities for Indigenous businesses and communities through meaningful subcontracting, employment, and training related to the proposed project. To align with these objectives, the successful proponents will be required to develop an Indigenous Benefits Plan (IBP) as part of the CM contract. The IBPs will outline proposed initiatives and opportunities for Indigenous participation, including subcontracting, employment, and training activities. Contract Award and Anticipated Security Requirements To be eligible for contract award, a proponent will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents. The anticipated security clearance level for this contract is Designated Organization Screening (DOS). Industrial Security Program Sponsorship Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing contractors early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, contractors that intend to submit a proposal for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC’s ISP. Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential proponents with their respective security clearance sponsorship process. To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC’s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements. In their sponsorship request application to DCC, contractors are asked to quote the following information, among other things: Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number (Project number on the MERX notice); Contract number 87654; and Level of clearance requested to be sponsored for. Sponsorship Process Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the contractors to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages. Once DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a contractor: has started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation (Contract number listed on their request for sponsorship) being advertised on MERX, has  met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package, and has submitted a proposal or a bid DCC will  send the documents to the Public Services and Procurement Canada’s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP). Following receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the proponent regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the proponent will need to promptly cooperate with CSP  to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible. Questions Any questions pertaining to the sponsoring process through the ISP can be addressed to: Telephone Number: (613) 998-8974; or Email address: ISP.Sponsorship@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Any questions relating to this Advance Procurement Notice can be addressed to: Eric Ndayambaza Coordinator, Contract Services Defence Construction Canada Eric.Ndayambaza@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Email: +(1) 343-576-9347 Disclaimer DCC is only providing assistance, at its entire discretion, for the above stated sponsorship process and does not provide any representations or guarantees that a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application forwarded by DCC to the CSP will be successful or result in the granting of the requested security clearance(s) by the CSP. At all times, the processing of a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application is subject to the respective terms, conditions, and timelines of DCC’s ISP sponsorship process and the CSP security clearance granting process. By applying to either of the aforementioned processes, the proponent agrees to bear any fees and risks associated with: (i) the completeness or accuracy, or lack thereof, of its application or related documents submitted under or in connection with either said processes, and (ii) the timeliness, or lack thereof, of any processing or granting of security clearance(s) under or in connection with either said processes. Notwithstanding anything else stated above, DCC shall in no event be liable to the proponent for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, consequential, punitive or exemplary damages arising out or in connection with the above stated sponsorship process.  Bidding and Documents are available on http://www.merx.com. Fees may apply; See https://www.merx.com/public/pricing for more information.

title: MP-160010 N01/42, 46 échangeur ZH-Nord – échangeur ZH-Est – échangeur de Brüttisellen
description:
Le projet N01/42, 46 échangeur ZH-Nord – échangeur ZH-Est – échangeur de Brüttisellen (abrégé : PZO) prévoit la réduction des goulets d’étranglement existants entre l’échangeur de Brüttisellen et l’échangeur de Zurich-Est, ainsi que l’amélioration de la fluidité du trafic. À cette fin, il est prévu de mettre en place une réaffectation permanente de la bande d’arrêt d’urgence (R-BAU) et de réaliser diverses mesures d’aménagement sur le tracé, les ouvrages d’art et les portiques de signalisation, y compris les équipements d’exploitation et de sécurité. D’autres éléments du projet sont l’assainissement du bruit (construction de 5 PAB, remplacement d’une PAB) et le traitement des eaux de chaussée (construction de 2 SABA).

Le présent mandat relatif aux travaux principaux du lot 4.1 « Gestion du trafic » du projet BSA (HA BSA lot 4.1 VL) comprend la fourniture, le montage et la mise en service de composants matériels (notamment des commandes locales, des commandes d’installation, des ordinateurs de zone, des systèmes de saisie des données de circulation, des afficheurs de texte variable et des boîtes à bornes) en complément du système de gestion du trafic existant. Le système de commande doit être conçu conformément à la directive OFROU 15 019 « Logique de régulation du trafic » et à la documentation OFROU 85 019 « Configuration et paramétrage », afin de permettre les fonctionnalités suivantes :

  • Réaffectation permanente de la bande d’arrêt d’urgence (R-BAU) sur divers tronçons
  • Harmonisation des vitesses et avertissement de danger (GHGW)
  • Gestion des voies de circulation (FLS)
  • Gestion des rampes (RDOS)
  • Enregistrement des données de trafic (EDT)
  • Affichage de messages variables (PMV)
  • Surveillance et commande du système

title: Netherlands – Administrative social services – Loonwaarde metingen
description: De gemeente is verantwoordlijk voor het verrichten van loonwaardenmetingen voor Haagse burgers (werknemers) die behoren tot de doelgroep potentieel arbeidsbeperkt. Aan de hand van de loonwaardenmeting wordt de hoogte van loonkostensubsidie berekend. Hiermee wordt de werkgever gecompenseerd in het verlies aan arbeidsprestatie en wordt hij in staat gesteld een bijdrage te leveren aan een inclusieve arbeidsmarkt en een duurzame arbeidsrelatie. De uitvoering en toekenning van loonwaardenmetingen wordt gedaan vanuit de Dienst Sociale zaken en Werkgelegenheid binnen het onderdeel Den Haag Werkt. Gemeente Den Haag zoekt één externe partner die als flexibele schil rondom de vaste loonwaarde deskundigen van de gemeente in staat is om - met gecertificeerde en in het loonwaarde register geregistreerde loonwaarde deskundigen - op jaarbasis circa 1170 kwalitatief goede loonwaardenmetingen te verrichten. Dit volgens de methodiek van landelijk vastgestelde uniforme loonwaardenmeting. De gemeente wil samenwerken met een vaste groep loonwaarde deskundigen omdat dit de samenwerking met de loonwaardendeskundigen van de gemeente – maar ook de dienstverlening aan de werkgevers ten goede komt. De gemeente Den Haag werkt met het loonwaarden meetsysteem van Competensys. De opdrachtnemer aan wie de opdracht gegund zal worden zal zelf zorg dienen te dragen voor het kunnen werken met het loonwaarden meetsysteem van Competensys en de mogelijke kosten die daaraan verbonden zijn. Ditzelfde geldt m.b.t. eventueel daaruit voortvloeiende bijscholing etc . Opdrachtnemer zal de loonwaarden metingen op locatie uitvoeren en werken in systemen van Opdrachtgever (Competensys). De gemeente wil een overeenkomst sluiten op basis van een resultaatverplichting, het uitvoeren van loonwaardenmetingen met het optimale resultaat, dat wil zeggen zoveel mogelijk rechtdoend aan de arbeidssituatie, voor de Gemeente Den Haag af te ronden. De opdracht betreft dus geen detachering of inhuur van personeel.

title: Slovakia – Construction work – Rekonštrukcia objektu KH Palace a prístavba bazénovej haly – wellness a balneoterapia, Kúpele Sliač
description: Predmetom zákazky je realizácia stavebných úprav, rekonštrukcie dotknutých častí objektu KH Palace, realizácia novej prístavby bazénovej haly, wellness a balneoterapeutických prevádzok vrátane súvisiacich technologických celkov a dopracovania projektovej dokumentácie pre realizáciu stavby. Predmet zákazky je zameraný najmä na rekonštrukciu a stavebné úpravy vybraných podzemných podlaží objektu KH Palace, realizáciu nových wellness a balneologických prevádzok, technologického zázemia a prístavby bazénovej haly vrátane súvisiacich stavebných, technologických a krajinárskych úprav. Projekt predstavuje strategickú investíciu do obnovy a rozvoja kúpeľného areálu Sliač s cieľom vytvoriť moderné liečebno-relaxačné centrum rešpektujúce historickú hodnotu objektu, kúpeľnú tradíciu lokality a súčasné požiadavky na wellness, rehabilitačné a balneologické prevádzky. Objekt KH Palace je národnou kultúrnou pamiatkou evidovanou v Ústrednom zozname pamiatkového fondu SR. Všetky zásahy musia rešpektovať historické, architektonické a kultúrne hodnoty objektu a jeho bezprostredného prostredia. Projekt bude realizovaný systémom generálneho zhotoviteľa v princípoch „Žltého FIDIC“, pričom predmetom zákazky je: – dopracovanie realizačnej projektovej dokumentácie, – koordinácia všetkých profesií, – realizácia stavebných častí, – realizácia wellness a balneo technológií, – uvedenie technológií do prevádzky, – vykonanie komplexných skúšok, – odovzdanie plne funkčného technologického a prevádzkového celku, – a zabezpečenie dokumentácie skutočného vyhotovenia. Podrobnejší opis predmetu zákazky tvorí prílohu č. 1 súťažných podkladov. Predmet zákazky zahŕňa všetky projektové, inžinierske, stavebné, montážne, technologické, koordinačné a súvisiace činnosti, dodávky, zariadenia, materiály a práce potrebné na dosiahnutie úplného, funkčného, bezpečného a prevádzkyschopného výsledku diela, a to aj v prípade, ak nie sú jednotlivo explicitne uvedené v opise predmetu zákazky alebo vo výkaze výmer, pokiaľ ich potreba objektívne vyplýva zo zadávacej dokumentácie, funkcie diela alebo z riadneho odborného vykonania predmetu zákazky.

description: Le présent marché est établi dans le cadre d’un groupement de commandes constitué des organismes publics cités ci-après ayant une activité de blanchisserie hospitalière et dénommé GROUPEMENT ACHAT TEXTILE SUD BRETAGNE INTERHOSPITALIER, « GATSBIH ». Il est précisé que le GCS Achats Santé Bretagne agit aussi en qualité de centrale d’achats conformément à sa convention constitutive.Son rôle est précisé ci-dessous. Article 1 Présentation de la centrale d’achat En vertu de ses statuts, le GCS Achats Santé Bretagne exerce l’activité permanente de centrale d’achat. En sa qualité de coordonnateur, le GIP SILGOM est le pouvoir adjudicateur du présent marché dans la limite de ses attributions définies à l’article 2.2. Les établissements adhérents, membres du groupement de commandes listés à l’article 2 ci-dessous. Les établissements bénéficiaires qui ne sont pas membres du groupement de commandes mais qui bénéficient de sa mise à disposition dans les conditions définies à l’article 3 ci-dessous. Article 2 Présentation du groupement de commandes Cette consultation s’inscrit dans le cadre d’un groupement de commandes constitué selon les règles définies par les articles L2113-6 et L2113-7 du Code de la Commande Publique et régi par une convention constitutive signée par ses adhérents. Le groupement de commandes est constitué des établissements suivants CH Centre Bretagne de Pontivy établissement support du GHT CENTRE BRETAGNE et agissant en son nom et au nom et pour le compte des établissements parties suivants : CH Guémené sur Scorff ; MAS Guémené sur Scorff ; GIP Blanchisserie interhospitalière de Cornouaille GIP Bretagne Santé LogistiqueL GIP SILGOM ; Article 2.1 Coordonnateur Le GIP SILGOM a été désigné en tant que coordonnateur du groupement de commandes. Un seul marché est conclu entre le(s) titulaire(s) et l’ensemble des adhérents du groupement, représentés par le coordonnateur. En phase de passation, le coordonnateur est chargé de : Déterminer le mode de dévolution et la procédure de passation appropriés pour satisfaire le besoin recensé ; Établir le dossier de consultation des entreprises en cohérence avec la politique achat établie par le GCS ; Assurer la publication des avis de pré information et avis d’appel public à concurrence ; Mener les procédures de publicité et de mise en concurrence ; Accomplir toutes les démarches nécessaires auprès des candidats et des soumissionnaires évincés ; Attribuer, signer et notifier le marché. En phase d’exécution, le coordonnateur est chargé de : Procéder aux modifications du marché, sous forme d’avenant ou de modification unilatérale ; Procéder aux reconductions du marché ; Prononcer la résiliation du marché ; Organiser un suivi d’exécution avec le(s) titulaires du marché ; Notifier au(x) titulaire(s) toute nouvelle mise à disposition du marché dans le cadre de la centrale d’achat. Article 2.2 Adhérents A l’exclusion des éléments expressément listés à l’article 2 ci-dessus, la phase d’exécution du marché relève de chaque établissement adhérent ou bénéficiaire. Par dérogation au CCAG applicable, les établissements adhérents et les établissements bénéficiaires ont la qualité d’acheteur pour l’exécution du marché, notamment pour : La conclusion des marchés subséquents, émission des bons de commande ou ordres de service ; Notification de toutes les décisions relatives à l’exécution du marché telles que visées dans les pièces du marché, à l’exclusion de celles expressément réservées au Coordonnateur ; Vérification, admission et réception des fournitures et prestations de services ou travaux ; Réception, traitement et règlement des factures ; Application des pénalités contractuelles. Article 3 Mise à disposition par la centrale d’achat aux établissements bénéficiaires En sa qualité de centrale d’achat, le GCS Achats Santé Bretagne peut mettre à disposition le présent marché public au bénéfice de ses établissements bénéficiaires, en ce compris dont l’adhésion est postérieure à la signature du marché. Cette mise à disposition est subordonnée au respect des conditions cumulatives suivantes : Limite géographique : les établissements de la région Bretagne Limite matérielle : - Établissements de santé, sociaux et médico-sociaux publics ainsi que les syndicats inter- hospitaliers dans l’attente de leurs transformations ; - Établissements de santé, sociaux et médico-sociaux privés d’intérêt collectif ou à but non lucratif ; - Établissements de santé relevant du Service de Santé des Armées ; - Groupements de coopération sanitaire et groupements de coopération sociale et médico-sociale ; - Groupements d’intérêt public et groupements d’intérêt économique dont l’objet concerne le champ sanitaire et / ou médico-social ; - Entités fédératrices de membres appartenant aux catégories ci-dessus mentionnées. Cette mise à disposition s’effectue par le biais d’une demande de mise à disposition acceptée par le GCS Achats Santé Bretagne après avis du Coordonnateur et notifiée au titulaire du marché par le Coordonnateur. A compter de la notification par le Coordonnateur de la demande de mise à disposition, l’établissement bénéficiaire devient, pour le présent marché, acheteur, dans les mêmes conditions que les établissements adhérents au groupement de commandes. La mise à disposition dans le cadre de la centrale d’achat ne constitue pas une modification du Marché. Il s’agit d’une mesure d’exécution. Elle ne donne donc pas lieu à une décision de modification unilatérale ni à la conclusion d’un avenant, sauf demande expresse du titulaire du marché. Le Titulaire est informé de chaque nouvelle mise à disposition par courrier du pouvoir adjudicateur (Coordonnateur), précisant notamment : La date de prise d’effet de la mise à disposition ; Les lots concerné...

title: STREL PARC, BLUARD, BLANCHERIE – Changement des vis d’Archimède et réalisation des auges en béton
description:
Le présent appel d'offres s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet de réfection et de modernisation des stations de relevage (STREL) du Parc, du Bluard et de la Blancherie, ainsi que du remplacement des vis d’Archimède associées. Ces ouvrages constituent des éléments essentiels du système d’amenée des eaux usées vers la STEP de l’ERM. Les inspections réalisées en 2025 ont mis en évidence :

  • une usure avancée des vis d’Archimède,
  • des dégradations structurelles (béton, cadres, ferblanteries),
  • des non-conformités électriques (mise à terre, câblages, sondes),
  • des contraintes hydrauliques critiques liées aux niveaux d’exploitation et aux débits futurs.

Le maître de l’ouvrage souhaite procéder à un remplacement complet des vis, accompagné des travaux de génie civil, d’électricité, de MCR et de serrurerie nécessaire au bon fonctionnement hydraulique et structurel des installations.

Le présent appel d'offres définit les exigences techniques, administratives et contractuelles auxquelles les entreprises invitées doivent répondre dans le cadre de l’appel d’offres.

title: Request for Information: Enterprise Training Infrastructure Project Scope Study and Feasibility Analysis
description: REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) The Office of Acquisition Management (OAM), on behalf of the Office of the Chief Administrative Officer (OCAO), is requesting information from qualified Architectural & Engineering (A/E) firms regarding a potential business opportunity supporting future United States Capitol Police (USCP) enterprise training infrastructure planning. The United States Capitol Police recently completed a Training Facilities Requirements Assessment (TFRA) which evaluated the Department's current enterprise training infrastructure and identified operational capacity, throughput, concurrency, facility condition, and infrastructure limitations affecting the Department's ability to sustain current and future training requirements. Building upon the findings of the TFRA, USCP is seeking a qualified Architectural & Engineering (A/E) firm to conduct an Enterprise Training Infrastructure Project Scope Study and Feasibility Analysis. The purpose of the study is to further evaluate the validated operational requirements identified within the TFRA and develop feasible infrastructure alternatives capable of supporting the Department's current and future enterprise training mission. The study is expected to evaluate multiple infrastructure strategies that may include modernization or expansion of existing facilities, construction of new facilities, acquisition or leasing of facilities, utilization of partner agency resources, relocation of selected training functions, and hybrid approaches incorporating multiple infrastructure solutions. The resulting study will provide executive leadership with engineering, planning, operational, and financial information necessary to objectively evaluate infrastructure alternatives and formulate a preferred path forward balancing operational requirements, implementation realities, fiscal considerations, and future enterprise training demand. Please see the attached Statement of Objectives (SOO) for additional information regarding the proposed requirement. Submission Details Please submit the following documents to Linh.Williams@uscp.gov : Vendor Capability Statement addressing the attached Statement of Objectives (SOO). Description of the firm's experience conducting comparable Architectural & Engineering feasibility studies, infrastructure planning efforts, campus planning initiatives, or comparable federal, military, law enforcement, or public safety facility planning projects. A recommended technical approach for accomplishing the objectives identified within the SOO. A recommended scope of services, anticipated deliverables, multidisciplinary team composition, and recommended Period of Performance (POP). A Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) budgetary estimate for the proposed effort. OAM is also interested in any recommendations vendors may have to improve the proposed requirement, study methodology, acquisition strategy, or future Statement of Work. Questions & Answers Please submit all questions in writing to Linh.Williams@uscp.gov using the Attachment B - Questions and Answers Template. USCP responses to contractors' questions will be provided as an attachment to this RFI notice and amended throughout the open period of this posting, as needed. It is the responsibility of the contractor to check this posting for updates. Terms of this Request The purpose of this Request for Information (RFI) is to collect additional information regarding the subject requirement and identify the willingness and capabilities of potential vendors to support the proposed effort. This RFI is issued solely for information or planning purposes and does not constitute a Request for Quote (RFQ). The information provided in this RFI is subject to change and is not binding on the Government. USCP has not made a commitment to procure the services discussed herein, and release of this RFI should not be construed as a commitment or authorization to incur costs for which reimbursement would be required or sought. All submissions become Government property and will not be returned. The USCP does not have authority to enter into contracts for architecture and engineering services or construction. The responses obtained from this RFI and any subsequent solicitation will be used to inform decision makers and stakeholders in Congress, the Legislative Branch, and partner agencies.

This project is considered a �Large-scale Construction Project� as defined in FAR 22.502 (DEVIATION 2026-O0040). Accordingly, the requirements of FAR Subpart 22.5 (DEVIATION 2026-O0040) will apply. title: KC-135 Center Console Refresh (CCR) Revision 2
description: 12 August Amendment 02 to revise documents as a result of Q&A. 28 Jul 26 Amendment 01 to revised documents as a result of Q&A. 10 Jul 26 Center Console Refresh addresses critical obsolescence issues within the KC-135 Refueling Tanker aircraft. The US Air Force needs an updated Fuel System (FS), Flight Display System (FDS), and Flight Computer due to obsolescence and is looking for innovative ideas to not only replace but improve these systems with turn-key solutions enabling supportability and future growth. The FS, FDS, Flight Computer, and the future growth/adaptability define the scope of the CCR program. The program scope also includes the addition of autothrottle systems. The anticipated contract will be a Cost-Plus Incentive Fee (CPIF) for EMD, Firm Fixed Price (FFP) for Production and Deployment (P&D), single award indefinite delivery/quantity type contract comprised of One (1) 48-month Base Period with Six (6) 1-Year Option Periods and a projected period of performance from July 2028 to June 2038. To request access to view-controlled documents on SAM.gov, you must have a role assigned in SAM.gov. Government personnel cannot assist with assigning roles. If you are unable to view the controlled documents, you will need to contact SAM.gov for assistance. Once your role has been assigned, submit a request to view the documents and ensure you include your company�s CAGE code. Failure to provide the CAGE code will delay your access request. Access to controlled documents will be granted only if your company has an active DD2345 is on file through the JCP website, https://www.public.dacs.dla.mil/jcp/ext/. If a DD2345 is not found or is inactive, it must be updated and active before access can be approved *Section 3.27.3 of the SRD will be updated at the next formal revision change to align with SOW Sections 2.2 and 13.4.3.

description: Le présent marché concerne les travaux anticipés (mesures VoMa) du pont sur le Rhône à Saint-Maurice situé sur le tronçon d’autoroute N09.56 Bex-Nord – Martigny. buyer: Ministry of Transport and Infrastructure, Directorate General of Infrastructure Investments
title: Türkiye – Railway construction works – Design and Construction of Infrastructure & Superstructure Works including Electrification under the İstanbul North Rail Crossing Project (INRAIL)
description: The Ministry of Transport and Infrastructure, Directorate General of Infrastructure Investments, Türkiye (hereinafter - teh Ministry), has received financing from the World Bank through Ministry of Treasury and Finance towards the cost of the INRAIL Project. The Project is being jointly financed by the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank, the Asian Development Bank, the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, the Islamic Development Bank, and the OPEC Fund for International Development. The Project will finance the construction of a 127 km greenfield railway line designed to bypass the Istanbul Metropolitan Area and establish a high-capacity overland link across the Istanbul Strait (Bosphorus). The line will be double-tracked, electrified, fully signalized, and mixed-use, capable of carrying both passengers and freight, with a maximum freight carrying capacity of 50 million tons per year. The proposed railway line will originate at Çayrova station on the Asian side and terminate at Çatalca station on the European side, crossing the Istanbul Strait by utilizing the existing track space allocated on the Yavuz Sultan Selim Bridge (YSS Bridge), also known as the Third Bosphorus Bridge, located at the northern end of the Istanbul Strait. The Ministry intends to apply a portion of the loan proceeds toward payments under the contract(s) for the "Design and Construction of Infrastructure and Superstructure Works, including Electrification" subdivided into four Lots as listed below. The scope of works covered under this procurement package as a whole (all four lots together) encompasses the design and construction including electrification of 122.3 km of double-track main line and 4.7 km of single-track connection lines, 5 twin-tube Tunnel Boring Machine (TBM) tunnels totaling 36.2 km, 22 double-track New Austrian Tunneling Method (NATM) tunnels totaling 23.3 km, 17 cut-and-cover tunnels totaling 3.7 km, two viaducts and 40 bridges totaling 22.1 km, Stations, etc. The scope of works covered under each lot is specified in the RFP document. The Telecommunication and Signalling Works are not included in this procurement package and will tendered separately. The Ministry now invites sealed Proposals from eligible Proposers for the Design and Construction of Infrastructure & Superstructure Works including Electrification subdivided into the four lots below. Proposers may submit Proposal for one or more lot(s): Lot 1 — Construction and Electrification Works for the Çayrova – Sabiha Gökçen Airport – Kurtdomu Corridor (28,49 km); Lot 2 — Construction and Electrification Works for the Kurtdomu – Alibahadr Corridor (25,76 km); Lot 3 — Construction and Electrification Works for the Alibahadr – YSS Bridge – Mithatpaa Corridor (32,14 km); Lot 4 — Construction and Electrification Works for the Mithatpaa – stanbul Airport – Çatalca Corridor (39,49 km).

description: Tällä hankintamenettelyllä perustetaan dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä, jonka puitteissa hankitaan Äänekosken, Jämsä-Kuhmoisen, Toivakan, Saarikan (Saarijärvi, Karstula, Kannonkoski,Kyyjärvi, Kivijärvi), Wiitaunionin (Viitasaari ja Pihtipudas), Laukaan, Muuramen, Keuruun, Kinnulan ja Hankasalmen (myöhemmin ”Hankintayksikön edustajat”) sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluiden henkilökuljetusten henkilöliikennekuljetuspalveluita tilaajien matkaoikeusasiakkaille. Henkilöliikennepalveluita käytetään hankintayksiköiden edustajille Vammaispalvelu-, Sosiaalihuolto-, Erityishuolto- ja Lastensuojelulain alaisiin sekä työ-, toimintakeskus-, päivätoiminta- ja päiväkeskusasiakkaiden kuljetuksiin. Jyväskylän kaupungilla on erillinen vastaavien kuljetusten hankintaan kohdennettu dynaaminen hankintäjärjestelmä jo käytössään, mutta Jyväskylän kaupunki siirtää edellä mainittujen henkilöliikennepalveluiden kuljetushankinnat tämän hankintajärjestelmän piiriin. Jyväskylän kaupunki siirtyy kuljetusalueellisesti maakunnalliseen henkilöliikenteen kuljetusalueeseen 15.1.2022 alkaen. Hankinnan tavoitteena on turvata kuljetuspalveluasiakkaiden yhdenvertainen, luotettava ja toimiva mahdollisuus lakisääteisiin kuljetusmatkoihin. Hankinta on laaja kokonaisuus, jossa pyritään hyvällä yhteistyöllä ja kehittämisellä luomaan selkeä ja ratkaisukeskeinen toimintamalli. Hankintayksikön edustajat tavoittelevat dynaamisella hankintajärjestelmällä sitä, että tarpeen mukaiset tarjouskilpailut voidaan toteuttaa joustavasti ja nopeasti. Tämän tavoitteen toteutumisen mahdollistaa mm. ennalta tiedossa olevat sopimusehdot. Hankintayksikön edustajat pyytävät hankinnasta kiinnostuneita ehdokkaita jättämään osallistumishakemuksen perustettavaan K-S Sote henkilöliikennepalveluita koskevaan dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään. Dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä on kaksivaiheinen. Ensimmäisessä vaiheessa dynaaminen hankintajärjestelmä perustetaan, ja toisessa vaiheessa dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään sisältyvät sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluiden henkilöliikennekuljetukset kilpailutetaan sisäisillä kilpailutuksilla. Kaikki soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttävät palveluntuottajat voivat liittyä dynaamiseen hankintajärjestelmään koko sen keston ajan, ja kaikki hankintajärjestelmään hyväksytyt palveluntuottajat voivat jättää tarjouksia kilpailutuksiin. Hankittava henkilöliikenne tulee Tilaajien hankkiman kyydinvälityspalvelukeskuksen ohjaukseen. Kyydinvälityspalvelun tarkoitus on kustannustehokas matkojen välittäminen, ohjaaminen ja yhdistely huomioiden asiakkaiden erilaiset vaatimukset ja tarpeet. Henkilöliikennettä voidaan suorittaa taksi- tai henkilöliikenneluvallisella kalustolla. Lisäksi edellytetään hankinta- asiakirjoissa edellytettyjen soveltuvuusehtojen täyttymistä. Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän voimassaoloaikana voimaan astuva Puhtaiden ajoneuvojen direktiivi voi muuttaa hankintajärjestelmän sisällä tehtävien hankintojen sisältöä käytettävän kaluston ympäristövaatimusten suhteen ja tästä johtuen palvelukuvaukseen voi tulla muutoksia vähäisissä määrin. Dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän perustamisvaiheessa maakunnallinen välityspalvelu on vielä kilpailutusvaiheessa, jonka vuoksi osa osallistumishakemuksen liitteenä olevan palvelukuvauksen tiedoista on avoimia. Avoimena olevat tiedot (mm. ajoneuvosovellukseen liittyvät) täydennetään hankintajärjestelmän sisällä tehtävään kilpailutuksen liitteeseen palvelukuvaus. Jyväskylän kaupungin kuljetusalue toimii yhteistyöalueesta irrallisena kokonaisuutena 15.1.2022 saakka. Tämän hankintajärjestelmän piirissä tullaan kilpailuttamaan myös kuljetushankinnat, jotka koskevat Jyväskylän kaupungin kuljetusaluetta nykyisen sopimuksen päättyessä 2.6.2021. Keuruun kaupunki aloittaa kuljetusalueellisesti 1.8.2021 alkaen. Jyväskylän ja Keuruun kaupunkien hankintamenettelyn kohteena olevat kuljetukset kilpailutetaan yhtäaikaa muiden tilaajien kuljetusalueiden yhteydessä, mutta sopimukset alkavat edellä maihittujen kaupunkien elueilla eri aikaan.

title: Germany – Bridge renewal construction work – Ersatzneubau der Heinrich-Weitz-Brücke in Linnich - Stadt Linnich
description: Ersatzneubau der Heinrich-Weitz-Brücke in Linnich Die Heinrich-Weitz-Brücke wurde 1949 errichtet und war bereits in den Jahren vor dem Hochwasserereignis infolge umfangreicher Schäden und Dauerhaftigkeitsprobleme in den wiederkehrenden Brückenprüfungen nur mit Zustandsnoten von 3,3 bzw. sogar 4,0 bewertet worden. Unmittelbar nach der Flutsituation wurde die Brücke einer Sonderbegut-achtung unterzogen und schließlich gänzlich für den Verkehr gesperrt. Seitdem ist die zentral in Linnich verlaufende Rurstraße unterbrochen und für die Einwohner sowie den Liefer- und Durchgangsverkehr nicht mehr nutzbar. title: Switzerland – Airport buildings construction work – Gesamtleister-Submission Rega Jet-Basis Zürich

Während der heutige Hauptsitz der Rega mit Helikopter-Instandhaltungsbetrieb und nationaler Luftrettungszentrale bis Ende 2030 nach Kägiswil verlegt wird, soll die gesamte Ambulanzjet-Operation als eigenständiger Bereich am Flughafen Zürich verbleiben. Diese Infrastruktur wird die FZAG als Bauherrin nach den betrieblichen Anforderungen der Rega planen und errichten. Die Rega wird die neue Jet-Basis als Mieterin nutzen. Die Jet-Basis umfasst im Teilprojekt Hochbau im Wesentlichen einen Hangar mit Platz für drei Ambulanzjets, die dazugehörigen Büroräumlichkeiten sowie die Erschliessung (alle landseitig) mit einer geschätzten Geschossfläche von insgesamt ca. 6'600 m². Im Rahmen der Gesamtleister-Submission ist ein Projektvorschlag sowie das verbindliche Angebot dazu gemäss den Anforderungen der FZAG und der Rega zu erstellen. Die Zusammenstellung des Teams ist dabei dem Anbieter überlassen.

title: Italy – Treasury services – Servizio di tesoreria comunale
description: Servizio di tesoreria comunale. L’affidamento del servizio di tesoreria oggetto del presente appalto, come previsto dall’art. 209 del D.lgs. n. 267/2000 e ss.mm.ii., è costituito dal “complesso delle operazioni legate alla gestione finanziaria dell’ente locale e finalizzate in particolare alla riscossione delle entrate, al pagamento delle spese, alla custodia di titoli e valori ed agli adempimenti connessi previsti dalla legge, dallo statuto, dai regolamenti dell’ente o da norme pattizie”. Il contratto e gli obblighi delle parti sono analiticamente descritti nella convenzione approvata con delibera di Consiglio Comunale n. 5 del 28.01.2026 e nel capitolato speciale. L’appalto è a corpo ed è costituito da un unico lotto in quanto, per le caratteristiche del servizio e le particolari modalità esecutive delle prestazioni, si rende necessaria una gestione unitaria ed omogenea da parte di un solo operatore economico, al fine di assicurare l’efficace coordinamento delle attività oggetto dell’appalto e l’ottimizzazione delle risorse. L’importo dell’appalto a base di gara per l’arco di durata quinquennale ammonta ad € 1.600.000,00 (euro unmilioneseicentomila/00), esente IVA. L’Ente ha provveduto a chiudere i dossier titoli in custodia presso la tesoreria comunale; pertanto, al ''corrispettivo omnicomprensivo del servizio di tesoreria e cassa'' si ritiene applicabile l'esenzione di cui all'articolo 10, primo comma, n. 1) del d.P.R. n. 633 del 1972 (giusta parere Agenzia delle Entrate Risposta n. 188/2023). L’importo a base di gara comprende i costi della manodopera che la stazione appaltante ha stimato pari ad € 203.580,00. In considerazione della natura del servizio oggetto della presente gara, non sussiste la necessità di procedere alla predisposizione del DUVRI ex D.lgs. 81/2008, tenuto conto altresì che il servizio si svolge presso le sedi del Tesoriere. La durata dell’appalto (escluse le eventuali opzioni) è di 5 anni naturali e consecutivi decorrenti dalla data di sottoscrizione della convenzione o dall’avvio del servizio o dalla data di esecuzione anticipata del servizio.

description: Le présent marché porte sur l'organisation de quatre éditions (2027, 2028, 2029 et 2030) des festivités données à l’occasion de la fête nationale les 21 juillet, (code CPV 7995200-2, services d'organisation d'événements relevant de l'annexe III de la loi du 17 juin 2016 relative aux marchés publics - services sociaux et autres services spécifiques). Le pouvoir adjudicateur choisit la procédure négociée directe avec publication préalable. Il s’agit d’un marché à prix global (A.R. 18 avril 2017, art. 2, 3°). Sous peine de nullité, les soumissionnaires devront proposer une offre de prix dont le montant est inférieur à 1.200.000 € TVA comprise pour chaque scénario ; déduction faite du montant de la redevance d’exploitation des bars fixée à 50.000 € TVA comprise. Le montant brut maximum de l’offre ne peut dès lors pas dépasser, par scénario, 1.249.999 €. (TVAC). De ce montant, il faut déduire la redevance d’exploitation des bars fixée à 50.000 € (TVAC) Le montant net de l’offre ne peut par conséquent pas dépasser, par édition, 1.199.999 € (TVAC). En raison de travaux de grande ampleur qui se dérouleront dans le Parc du Cinquantenaire entre 2027 et 2029, l’événement pourrait être organisé selon deux configurations, à savoir : • Scénario 1, privilégié pour les éditions 2027 et 2030 : esplanade du Cinquantenaire (côté Schuman) avec le public autour des jardins à la française et dans le parc du Cinquantenaire. • Scénario 2, privilégié pour les éditions 2028 et 2029 : esplanade du Cinquantenaire (côté Mérode) avec le public sur l’esplanade côté Mérode, autour du bassin et dans le prolongement de l’avenue de Tervuren ; Le pouvoir adjudicateur ne maitrise pas le planning du chantier dont il n’est pas le maître d’ouvrage et ne peut dès lors pas garantir, à ce stade, que le planning des travaux sera respecté. La mise en œuvre d’un autre scénario que le scénario privilégié pourrait dès lors être envisagé pour l’une ou l’autre édition. Le pouvoir adjudicateur tient à signaler que l’édition 2030 coïncidera avec le bicentenaire de la Belgique.

title: Belgium – Survey services – ECOHYDROLOGISCHE STUDIE KIKBEEK en SBZ MECHELSE HEIDE
description: Aanleiding voor de opstart van de ecohydrologische studie zijn de stabiliteitsproblemen in de plas Kikbeek, waardoor de peilstijgingen in functie van bereiken van de instandhoudingsdoelstellingen momenteel niet kunnen doorgaan. Om te onderzoeken wat de effecten zijn van hogere plaspeilen (dan de huidige) in de Kikbeekgroeve op de omliggende grondwaterafhankelijke vegetaties is voorwerp van de ecohydrologische studie. Bijkomend wordt onderzocht welke aanvullende maatregelen voor vernatting in het habitatrichtlijngebied de Mechelse Heide, Ziepbeekvallei, Neerharerheide en Asbeek noodzakelijk zijn om tot een klimaatrobuust systeem te komen. Doel van de studie is het onderzoek naar de impact op grondwaterstanden en de randvoorwaarden vanuit ecologie door peilstijgingen van de plas Kikbeek en van hydrologische herstelmaatregelen in het de Mechelse Heide, Ziepbeek, Neerharerheide en Asbeek. Dit moet leiden tot het maximaliseren van het herstel en de instandhouding van de grondwaterafhankelijke vegetaties. Doelstelling is te komen tot klimaatrobuust systeemherstel, zonder de kritieke infrastructuur (zoals de autosnelweg E314) en de stabiliteit van de groeve Berg en de Kikbeekplas op lange termijn te hypothekeren. De opmaak van hydrologische en ecologische modelvoorspellingen moeten dienen om scenario’s voor peilstijging in de plas Kikbeek te onderzoeken en de ontwikkeling van natte natuur in het habitatrichtlijngebied van de Mechelse Heide uit te werken en te evalueren.

title: Switzerland – Construction work – N8 / Lungern Nord – Giswil Süd: Baulos 21 Trassee und Kunstbauten Nord
description: Im Bereich zwischen dem Südportal des bestehenden Tunnels Giswil und dem neuen Tunnel Kaiserstuhl (separate, bereits erfolgte Vergabe als Baulos 19) wird die Strasseninfrastruktur erweitert, damit künftig National- und Kantonsstrasse getrennt über zwei separate Trassees geführt werden können. Das heutige Trassee der Brünigstrasse verläuft über die bestehende Buochholzbrücke, am OWi-Land vorbei zum Lungerersee. Die bestehende Buochholzbrücke wird nach Eröffnung des Tunnels Kaiserstuhl für die Nationalstrasse genutzt. Für die Kantonsstrasse wird parallel zur bestehenden Brücke eine neue Strassenbrücke erstellt (separate bereits erfolgte Vergabe als Baulos 20). Im vorliegenden Baulos 21 werden die Leistungen für den Lückenschluss zwischen dem Bereich Griffeldossen/Buochholz (Baulos 20) und Tunnel Kaiserstuhl (Baulos 19) beschafft. Die Leistungen umfassen Trasseearbeiten für National- und Kantonsstrasse mit Stützbauwerken sowie einer SABA, einem PW, Geländemodellierungen im Bereich Marchgraben, Wasserbauarbeiten sowie kleinere Kunstbauten. Mit der vorliegenden Beschaffung werden Leistungen für Baumeisterarbeiten für die nachfolgend beschriebenen Hauptarbeiten beschafft: Strassenbau und Werkleitungsbau ------------------------------------------ Neubau Nationalstrasse auf ca. 500 m Länge (insgesamt rund 7'500 m2 Fläche) inkl. ¾-Anschluss Giswil Süd sowie Strassenumbau bestehende Brünigstrasse auf ca. 400 m Länge (insgesamt rund 4'000 m2 Fläche) und Neubau Flurstrassen. Jeweils inkl. Unterbau, Entwässerung Belag und Markierung sowie diverse Werkleitungsumlegungen, -provisorien und -neubauten (u.a. neue Löschwasserleitung für Tunnel Kaiserstuhl). Dazu werden im Perimeter die neue SABA Schwendiboden und das Stapelbecken Nordportal gebaut (Baugrubensicherung mit Rühl- und Nagelwand). Ergänzend werden mit diesem Baulos die Leistungen für den Deckbelagsbau (ca. 16'000 m2) und Markierung (2.1 km Länge) des Tunnels Kaiserstuhl (Baulos 19) beschafft. Geländemodellierung und Wasserbau ------------------------------------------ Anpassung des Gerinnes (Ober- und Unterlauf) und des Geschiebesammlers Marchgraben (Blocksteinsohle, ca. 2’500 m2), sowie Neubau flachfundiertes Abschlussbauwerk Marchgraben (Stahlbeton-Durchlass mit 6.2 m Spannweite). Diverse Geländemodellierungsarbeiten im Bereich Marchgraben und Trassee (Abtrag ca. 25'000 m3 und Schüttungen ca. 35'000 m3). Neubau Stützbauwerke und Kunstbauten: ------------------------------------------ Erstellung von zwei je rund 140 m langen, bis zu 9 m hohen Winkelstützmauern inkl. Hinterfüllung (ca. 5’500 m3) und des Portalbauwerks Nord Tunnel Kaiserstuhl im Bereich des neuen N8-Trassees. Baugruben sind bereits in einem Vorlos (Baulos 17a) erstellt worden. Arbeiten teilweise unter Verkehr.

title: V1502 EV Enge Seewasserleitungen
description:
As part of this procurement procedure, the lake water intake and return pipelines for the lake water pumping station of the Energieverbund Enge are being tendered.

Lake water is abstracted through the intake pipeline at a depth of 15 m. It flows by gravity into the pump room, where it passes through the heat exchangers and is subsequently pumped back into the lake via the return pipeline.

Both pipelines run underground from the pump room at right angles to the shoreline to a depth of approximately 12 m. From there, they emerge from the ground and continue along the lakebed to the respective intake and return points.

The intake pipeline has a length of 490 m, while the return pipeline has a length of 480 m. The intake pipeline enters the pump room at an elevation of 403.50 m above sea level. The pipe entry elevation is approximately 2.5 m (pipe centreline) below the mean water level of Lake Zurich.

title: Servizio di tesoreria comunale
description: Servizio di tesoreria comunale. L’affidamento del servizio di tesoreria oggetto del presente appalto, come previsto dall’art. 209 del D.lgs. n. 267/2000 e ss.mm.ii., è costituito dal “complesso delle operazioni legate alla gestione finanziaria dell’ente locale e finalizzate in particolare alla riscossione delle entrate, al pagamento delle spese, alla custodia di titoli e valori ed agli adempimenti connessi previsti dalla legge, dallo statuto, dai regolamenti dell’ente o da norme pattizie”. Il contratto e gli obblighi delle parti sono analiticamente descritti nella convenzione approvata con delibera di Consiglio Comunale n. 5 del 28.01.2026 e nel capitolato speciale. L’appalto è a corpo ed è costituito da un unico lotto in quanto, per le caratteristiche del servizio e le particolari modalità esecutive delle prestazioni, si rende necessaria una gestione unitaria ed omogenea da parte di un solo operatore economico, al fine di assicurare l’efficace coordinamento delle attività oggetto dell’appalto e l’ottimizzazione delle risorse. L’importo dell’appalto a base di gara per l’arco di durata quinquennale ammonta ad € 1.600.000,00 (euro unmilioneseicentomila/00), esente IVA. L’Ente ha provveduto a chiudere i dossier titoli in custodia presso la tesoreria comunale; pertanto, al ''corrispettivo omnicomprensivo del servizio di tesoreria e cassa'' si ritiene applicabile l'esenzione di cui all'articolo 10, primo comma, n. 1) del d.P.R. n. 633 del 1972 (giusta parere Agenzia delle Entrate Risposta n. 188/2023). L’importo a base di gara comprende i costi della manodopera che la stazione appaltante ha stimato pari ad € 203.580,00. In considerazione della natura del servizio oggetto della presente gara, non sussiste la necessità di procedere alla predisposizione del DUVRI ex D.lgs. 81/2008, tenuto conto altresì che il servizio si svolge presso le sedi del Tesoriere. La durata dell’appalto (escluse le eventuali opzioni) è di 5 anni naturali e consecutivi decorrenti dalla data di sottoscrizione della convenzione o dall’avvio del servizio o dalla data di esecuzione anticipata del servizio.

title: APN - Housing Construction Plan
description: Advance Procurement Notice Housing Construction plan Purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. This is an advance notice for potential contracts to provide interested Design-Builders an opportunity to learn about the upcoming housing construction program. Note that there is no guarantee that these solicitations will proceed. Description of the Program and Services The Canadian Forces Housing Agency (CFHA) is planning a Housing Program to support the delivery of new residential housing for members of the Canadian Armed Forces at bases and wings across Canada. CFHA is responsible for the provision and management of military housing on Department of National Defence (DND) lands, and this program supports ongoing efforts to modernize and expand the housing portfolio to meet current and future operational needs. The objective of the program is to deliver new housing efficiently and at speed through Modified Design -Build (MDB) delivery model that integrates studies, design and construction under a single contract. The services required under this program include: Architectural & Engineering (A&E) services for the provision site studies, planning and detailed design development and all associated works. Design and construction of new infrastructure and housing to support the residential housing program. Note that certain locations may involve phased delivery. Planned building types will emphasize higher-density development, primarily mid-rise apartment buildings. The proposed number of units at each location is subject to adjustment as requirements are finalized. It is anticipated that each location will be delivered under its own Modified Design-Build (MDB) contract. However, subject to change, certain locations may be bundled and procured through a single Request for Proposals (RFP), as outlined below in no particular order. Location / Proposed Number of Housing Units / Estimated Design and Construction Costs ($M) RFP No.1 (Published) Comox, British Columbia/ 212 units/ $96M Esquimalt, British Columbia/ 200 units/ $91M RFP No.2 (Published) Ottawa, Ontario/ 280 units/ $128M RFP No.3 (Published) Yellowknife, Northwest Territories/ 32 units / $15M RFP No.4 (Published) Gagetown, New Brunswick/ 656 units / $323M Greenwood, Nova Scotia/ 208 units / $95M Halifax, Nova Scotia/ 400 units /$182M RFP No.5 (Published) Montreal, Quebec/ 200 units/ $91M Valcartier, Quebec/ 1120 units/ $510M Bagotville, Quebec/240 units/ $109M It is anticipated that the following solicitations related to this program will be initiated in Fall 2026. This is conditional on receiving approval to proceed by the Department of National Defence (DND). RFP No.6 Wainwright, Alberta/ 94 units/ $43M Cold Lake, Alberta/ 232 units/ $106M Edmonton, Alberta/ 1010 units/ $459M RFP No.7 Winnipeg, Manitoba/ 240 units/ $110M Shilo, Manitoba/ 184 units/ $84M RFP No.8 Borden, Ontario/ 210 units / $96M Kingston, Ontario/ 960 units/ $437M North Bay, Ontario/ 78 units/ $36M Petawawa, Ontario/ 1114 units/ $507M RFP No.9 Moose Jaw, Saskatchewan/ 24 units/ $11M The Government of Canada is committed to advancing reconciliation and fostering meaningful engagement with Indigenous Peoples. In alignment with these commitments, the Department of National Defence (DND) seeks to create opportunities for Indigenous businesses and communities through (sub)contracting, employment, and training initiatives associated with the proposed program of work. It is anticipated that Indigenous communities will benefit from potential subcontracting, employment, and training opportunities arising from this program of work. Questions Any questions relating to this Advance Procurement Notice can be addressed to: Antoine am Rhyn Regional Service Line Leader, Contract Services Defence Construction Canada 819-431-7650 Antoine.amrhyn@dcc-cdc.gc.ca    Bidding and Documents are available on http://www.merx.com. Fees may apply; See https://www.merx.com/public/pricing for more information.

title: N8 / Lungern Nord – Giswil Süd : Lot 21 – Tracé et ouvrages d’art Nord
description:
Dans le secteur situé entre le portail sud du tunnel existant de Giswil et le nouveau tunnel de Kaiserstuhl (objet d’une attribution distincte déjà réalisée, en tant que lot de construction 19), l’infrastructure routière est étendue afin qu’à l’avenir la route nationale et la route cantonale puissent être exploitées séparément sur deux tracés distincts.

Le tracé actuel de la route du Brünig passe par le pont existant de Buochholz, longe l’OWi-Land et se dirige vers le lac de Lungern. Après la mise en service du tunnel de Kaiserstuhl, le pont existant de Buochholz sera utilisé pour la route nationale. Pour la route cantonale, un nouveau pont routier sera construit parallèlement au pont existant (objet d’une attribution distincte déjà réalisée, en tant que lot de construction 20).

Le présent lot de construction 21 porte sur les travaux nécessaires pour combler la lacune entre le secteur de Griffeldossen/Buochholz (lot de construction 20) et le tunnel de Kaiserstuhl (lot de construction 19). Les prestations comprennent les travaux de réalisation des tracés de la route nationale et de la route cantonale, avec des ouvrages de soutènement, ainsi qu’une SABA, un PW, des modelages du terrain dans le secteur du Marchgraben, des travaux hydrauliques et de petits ouvrages d’art.

Le présent marché porte sur les prestations de travaux de gros œuvre relatives aux principaux travaux décrits ci-après:


Construction routière et construction des réseaux

---------------------------------------------------

Construction d’une nouvelle route nationale sur environ 500 m de longueur (soit une surface totale d’environ 7’500 m²), y compris le raccordement ¾ Giswil Sud, ainsi que réaménagement de la route du Brünig existante sur environ 400 m (soit une surface totale d’environ 4’000 m²) et construction de chemins agricoles. Les travaux comprennent notamment les couches de fondation, le drainage, le revêtement et le marquage, ainsi que divers déplacements, installations provisoires et constructions nouvelles de réseaux de services (notamment une nouvelle conduite d’eau d’extinction pour le tunnel de Kaiserstuhl).

Dans le périmètre, les nouveaux ouvrages SABA Schwendiboden ainsi que le bassin de rétention du portail nord seront également construits (soutènement de fouille par paroi berlinoise et paroi clouée).

En complément, ce lot comprend également les travaux de réalisation de la couche de roulement (environ 16’000 m²) et du marquage (2,1 km de longueur) du tunnel de Kaiserstuhl (lot 19).


Modelage du terrain et aménagement hydraulique

----------------------------------------------------

Adaptation du lit du cours d’eau (cours amont et aval) et du piège à matériaux charriés du Marchgraben (radier en blocs de pierre, env. 2’500 m²), ainsi que construction d’un nouvel ouvrage de fermeture à fondation superficielle au Marchgraben (passage en béton armé d’une portée de 6,2 m).

Divers travaux de modelage du terrain dans le secteur du Marchgraben et de l’emprise de la route, avec environ 25’000 m³ de déblais et 35’000 m³ de remblais.


Construction d’ouvrages de soutènement et d’ouvrages d’art

---------------------------------------------------------------

Construction de deux murs de soutènement en L, d’environ 140 m de longueur chacun et pouvant atteindre 9 m de hauteur, y compris le remblayage (env. 5’500 m³), ainsi que de l’ouvrage du portail nord du tunnel de Kaiserstuhl dans le secteur du nouveau tracé de la N8.

Les fouilles ont déjà été réalisées dans le cadre d’un lot préalable (lot 17a). Les travaux seront réalisés en partie sous circulation.

Primary locations are the Beckley VA Medical Center, Louis A. Johnson VA Medical Center (Clarksburg), and Hershel "Woody" Williams VA Medical Center (Huntington). Additional information on VA facilities can be found at https://www.va.gov/find-locations/ . Description of Work: Multiple firm-fixed unit price Blanket Purchase Agreements (BPAs) will be established to provide Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) repair and maintenance services across Beckley VA Medical Center, Louis A. Johnson VA Medical Center (Clarksburg), Hershel "Woody" Williams VA Medical Center (Huntington), and with a surge capacity to service all associated clinics. Switches, relays, outlets, lamps, bulbs (standard and LED), and general electrical gear Elevator support systems (electrical aspects) Switchgear, troubleshooting, repair, replacement Automatic Compressed gas system components (air, oxygen, vacuum) Medical gas analysis and certification Leak repair Pipe insulation and labeling Sewer and storm drain systems Unplugging and servicing toilets, urinals, sinks, and showers Grease trap and sump pump servicing Steam system testing, repair, and demolition Heating hot water/chilled water loops, water balancing Underground fire line, irrigation line, building drain, sewer, and domestic water piping and valves Excavation for repairs/replacement Backflow device testing and repair Plumbing fixture installation, replacement, repair, or removal Emergency eye wash and shower repair or replacement Pressure vessel installation, certification, and repair Steam system components (traps, valves, pumps) Water pumps, reverse osmosis stations, water softeners, chlorination stations, water filters Plumbing demolition Licensing & Warranty Requirements: The prime contractor must hold valid West Virginia contractor licenses for Plumbing and HVAC-R. All prime and subcontractor personnel must have appropriate licensures and certifications. All materials, equipment, software, and labor provided must be warranted by the prime contractor for one year from operational start. All facility parts, materials, or software must be approved by the VA prior to installation; obsolete or proprietary systems are not permitted. All work products and project bid information created under this contract becomes the sole intellectual property of the VA. Period Of Performance and Value: Multiple straight 5-year Blanket Purchase Agreements (BPAs) will be awarded, each consisting of five ordering periods. These BPAs will facilitate the issuance of firm fixed price BPA call orders over a total period of five years. title: Industry Day U.S. Merchant Marine Academy Campus Modernization
description: FALL FY27 INDUSTRY DAY U.S. Merchant Marine Academy Campus Modernization Industry Day Special Notice | Thursday, October 15, 2026 Event Overview The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), New York District, and the U.S. Merchant Marine Academy (USMMA) will host the Fall FY27 Industry Day from 11:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. Eastern Time on October 15, 2026. The hybrid event will bring industry, government, community organizations, and other interested attendees together with USMMA and USACE leadership for an updated view of the Campus Modernization Initiative, its strategic direction, and anticipated procurement activity. This event is open to the general public, and interested vendors. The FY27-FY28 forecast will emphasize the substantial heavy construction opportunities central to the modernization program while also addressing utility upgrades and complementary supporting and non-construction requirements. In-person participation is strongly encouraged. Prior registration is required for every attendee and closes at 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time on October 12, 2026. Event Information Event: USMMA Campus Modernization Fall FY27 Industry Day Date: Thursday, October 15, 2026 Event Time: 11:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. Eastern Time Check-In: Opens at 10:00 a.m.; in-person attendees should arrive no later than 10:45 a.m. to allow at least 15 minutes for networking before the program begins Location: U.S. Merchant Marine Academy, 300 Steamboat Road, Kings Point, NY 11024; enter through the main gate Format: Hybrid; in-person attendance is strongly encouraged. Registered virtual attendees will receive a Microsoft Teams link on October 13, 2026 Audience: All interested attendees age 16 or older (public attendees welcome) Registration Deadline: 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time, Monday, October 12, 2026 Theme: USACE Partnering with Industry and the Local Community Industry Day Highlights The Industry Day program will include the following: Welcome and Keynote Remarks: USACE leadership, USMMA Academy leadership, and invited guests will discuss the modernization program, acquisition approaches, and community impacts. Strategic Program Overview: A general USMMA overview and FY27-FY28 Campus Modernization update, including the strategic vision, updated waterfall chart, and local-government and community considerations. Heavy Construction Forecast: A focused review of the significant heavy construction opportunities expected to drive the modernization program. Specific project names, dollar ranges, and acquisition methods will be presented at the event rather than released in this notice. Supporting and Utility Requirements: Discussion of utility upgrades and complementary non-construction requirements that support successful delivery of the broader construction program. Executive Panel and Q&A: A moderator-led discussion with USMMA leadership, USACE program representatives, and USACE Contracting, including questions and topics submitted by industry. Doing Business with the Government: A practical session presented by the USACE Office of Small Business Programs. Campus Tour and Networking: A campus tour and opportunities to engage with program managers, technical staff, government representatives, community stakeholders, and industry peers. Advance Industry Questions: Industry partners may submit proposed questions or discussion topics for the executive panel to Zachery.A.Bernard@usace.army.mil no later than September 30, 2026. Registration and Access Information Registration is required for every attendee, regardless of affiliation or attendance method. Email the information below to Zachery.A.Bernard@usace.army.mil no later than 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time on Monday, October 12, 2026. Use the subject line "USMMA FY27 Industry Day Registration." One representative may register multiple attendees, but the required information must be provided separately for each person. Full legal name of each attendee Organization, company, or other affiliation, if applicable Individual email address and telephone number for each attendee Attendance method: in person or virtual Company website, if applicable Current capability statement for industry participants Virtual Attendance: A Microsoft Teams link will be emailed to registered virtual attendees on October 13, 2026. In-person attendance is strongly encouraged. Campus Access Requirements All in-person attendees must present a valid REAL ID-compliant credential or another form of government-issued photo identification acceptable to USMMA security and comply with all campus-entry instructions provided to registered attendees. Logistics and Parking Campus Entrance: Use the main gate at 300 Steamboat Road, Kings Point, NY 11024. Parking: Free attendee parking is available in Marvin Lot; overnight parking is not permitted. Arrival: Check-in opens at 10:00 a.m. Allow time to enter, park, and walk to the event location; arrive no later than 10:45 a.m. for networking. On-Site Directions: Follow posted signs and directions from USMMA security and event personnel. Updates, Changes, and Cancellations Any material change to the schedule, format, access procedures, or event status will be announced through an amendment to this SAM.gov notice and by email to registered attendees. Notice Status and Disclaimer This announcement is for informational and advance-planning purposes only and is not a solicitation or Government commitment to award a contract. The Government will not reimburse costs associated with this notice or event. Attendance is not required to participate in a future acquisition, and all event information is subject to change. Primary Point of Contact Name: Zachery A. Bernard Title: Deputy, Office of Small Business Programs (OSBP) Organization: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, North Atlantic Division - New York District Email: Zachery.A.Bernard@usace.army.mil Registration Email Subject: USMMA FY27 Industry Day Registration END OF SPECIAL NOTICE

title: RESERVE BASIN MAINTENANCE DREDGING CONTRACT FOR SITES AT THE PHILDELPHIA NAVY YARD IN THE PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT PENNSYLVANIA AREA OF RESPONSIBILIY
description: The project consists of Maintenance Dredging within the North Side (Wharf N) of Reserve Basin and Schuylkill River Access Channel for the Government sites at the Philadelphia Navy Yard in the Public Works Department Pennsylvania area of responsibility. Maintenance dredging of approximately 96,611 cubic yards of sediment, using a sealed environmental clamshell bucket. Dredging within the Reserve Basin is in support of the Naval Support Activity Mechanicsburg, Philadelphia Navy Yard Annex. The Reserve Basin is being used to decommission various US Naval vessels. For the river pilots to be able to safely maneuver vessels through the Schuylkill River into the Reserve Basin berths and to ensure that tidal cycles will not cause sediment accumulation around the hulls making final removal very difficult, the berths need to be dredged to a minimum depth of -30 MLLW and a maximum over-dredge depth of -32 MLLW.

REQUIREMENTS The contractor shall maintain a quality control system which meets the requirements of Mil-I-45208A, Mil-Q 9858,ISO-9000 / 9001 / 9002 or equivalent. RESPONSIBILITY FOR INSPECTION: Unless otherwise specified, the contractor is responsible for the performance of all inspection requirements as specified herein. Except as otherwise specified, the contractor may use his own or any other facility suitable for the performance of the inspection requirements specified herein. PROCEDURES:The contractor shall prepare and maintain Quality Control Documentation, test and repair procedures, and inspection procedures which shall be made available to the Government for review and approval. The procedures shall include sequential diagrams of the test, repair, and inspection process, as well as the performance spcifications to perform the procedures. QUALITY ASSURANCE PROGRAM PLAN: The contractor shall develop, implement and maintain a Repair Quality Plan in compliance with the requirements of Mil-I-45208A, Mil-Q-9858, ISO,9000 / 9001 / 9002, or equvalent.The plan shall define the specific methods by which compliance with contractual requirements will be assured. All quality assurance data shall be provided to the Government for review and approval upon request. PURCHASED MATERIAL CONTROL: The contractor shall establish and maintain a system of control over purchased material which shall assure that the necessary requirements of this contract are included. in all sub contract agreements. A parts control system shall establish a record of performance for each purchased and internally manufactured part and shall be used to evaluate continued use of the source. The contractors control system shall be in compliance wil either Mil-I 45208A/Mil-Q-9858 or equivalent Quality Quality Assurance Standared.(ISO/AS:9000, 9001, 9002). RECEIVING INSPECTION OF PURCHASED MATERIAL: Purchased items shall be inspected upon receipt at the contractors facility to assure conformance with all requirements of the Technical Data Package (TDP). Evidence of such inspections shall be maintained for Government review at least twelve (12) months following acceptance of the end item. Inspection reports shall be maintained by the contractor. The inspection report shall, at a minimum, include a record of all dimensional data (coordinate/positional), material, finish, and process with appropriate pass/fail criteria, such ascertifications, and actual dimensional readings. FAILURE ANALYSIS AND CORRECTIVE ACTION:All failure analysis and corrective action reports/plans shall be submitted to the Government. NONCONFORMING MATERIAL:The contractor shall establish an effective system for controlling nonconforming material including procedures for identification, segregation, and disposition. CONTRACTOR INTERNAL REVIEW BOARD (IRB):IRB authority is delegated to the contractor for this contract only. The IRB may be used only for disposition of materials exhibiting minor non-conformances, scrap or rework to return a part to conformance with drawings or specifications as authorized by the approved repair procedures.IRB shall not use "AS-IS" disposition. A complete file of IRB actions shall be maintained for review by the Government for concurrance of classification. MATERIAL REVIEW BOARD (MRB):Formal MRB authority for disposition of "AS-IS"and for minor non-conformances is retained by the Government. The contractor shall submit the appropriate request for Variance via the DCMC to the NAVSUP Contracting Officer. RESPONSIBILITY FOR COMPLIANCE: All items must meet all requirements of this Statement of Work. The inspection requirements set forth in this SOW shall become part of the contractors overall inspection system or quality program. title: Gemeindeberatung im Rahmen der energieberatungAARGAU - Region Zentrum
description:
Im Rahmen der Gemeindeberatung der energieberatungAARGAU – eine Dienstleistung des Kantons Aargau - werden Gemeinden durch sieben regional aktive Gemeindeberatende unterstützt. Sie verfügen über einen persönlichen Bezug zur Region und können damit den wirtschaftlichen, gesellschaftlichen und politischen Besonderheiten Rechnung tragen. Sie beraten die Gemeinden in Energiefragen, wie zum Beispiel bei gemeindeeigenen Liegenschaften, der kommunalen Energieplanung oder der Weiterentwicklung der Nutzungsplanung. Weiter betreiben sie Öffentlichkeitsarbeit und sind Ansprechpartner für Veranstaltungen rund ums Thema Bauen und Energie.

Ziel der Gemeindeberatung ist es, die Gemeinden bei der Bewältigung ihrer Aufgaben zur Erreichung der Energie- und Klimaziele bis 2050 zu begleiten und zu unterstützen. Dazu stehen den Gemeindeberatenden verschiedene Beratungsdienstleistungen zur Verfügung, die sie den Gemeinden weitestgehend kostenlos anbieten können. Zu den Dienstleistungen gehören:

  • Information und Motivation der Gemeinden zur aktiven Berücksichtigung energetischer Anliegen bei politischen Entwicklungen. Vorstellen von Produkten und Dienstleistungen seitens des Kantons, des Bundes und deren Netzwerkpartner. Mögliche Themen sind: Energieleitbilder, Gemeindeenergiekonzepte, kommunale Energieplanungen, Energiebuchhaltungen, Fördermassnahmen, etc.
  • Umfassende Beurteilung von Gebäudehülle und haustechnischen Anlagen gemeindeeigener Liegenschaften. Potenziale von Effizienzsteigerungsmassnahmen und der rationelle und umweltschonende Einsatz von Energie werden aufgezeigt.

title: 2026 Albuquerque Area IHS Native American-Owned Small Business Industry Day
description: ? Celebrating Our 6th Annual Industry Day � Connecting Native-Owned Businesses with Albuquerque Area Indian Health Service (IHS) ? Monday, September 28 & Tuesday, September 29, 2026 ? 9:00 a.m. � 3:00 p.m. Mountain Daylight Time (MDT) ? Virtual Event | Microsoft Teams ?? FREE to Participate ? Space is limited. Registration will close once all vendor presentation slots have been filled. The Albuquerque Area Indian Health Service (IHS), Division of Contracts and Grants Management (DCGM), invites Native American-owned small businesses to participate in the 2026 Albuquerque Area IHS Native American-Owned Small Business Industry Day, a two-day virtual event dedicated to strengthening partnerships, expanding the Albuquerque Area IHS supplier base, and increasing awareness of the capabilities of Native American-owned businesses. Held shortly before Indigenous Peoples� Day, this event provides Native American-owned small businesses, including eligible Small Business Indian Firms (SBIFs) and Indian Small Business Economic Enterprises (ISBEEs), an opportunity to introduce their organizations and showcase their capabilities directly to Albuquerque Area IHS acquisition professionals, program stakeholders, and organizational leadership. ?? Event Overview Day One will begin with introductions from Albuquerque Area IHS acquisition professionals and a brief overview of the Buy Indian Act and its role in supporting Indian economic enterprises through federal procurement. Following the opening session, participating vendors will receive an individually scheduled 10-minute presentation slot to introduce their businesses and highlight their capabilities, qualifications, products, services, past performance, and other information relevant to potential Albuquerque Area IHS requirements. Vendor capability presentations will continue throughout both days. ? Vendor Capability Presentations This is your opportunity to show Albuquerque Area IHS what your business can do! Each participating vendor will receive 10 minutes to present its capabilities directly to Albuquerque Area IHS personnel and other invited IHS acquisition and program professionals. Vendors are encouraged to use their presentation time to highlight information such as: Core capabilities and areas of expertise Products and/or services offered Relevant experience and past performance Geographic areas served Unique capabilities or solutions How your business can support IHS healthcare operations and mission requirements ? Who Will Be in the Audience? The Industry Day is designed to connect Native American-owned businesses with Albuquerque Area IHS personnel and other invited IHS acquisition and program professionals involved in identifying requirements, conducting market research, planning acquisitions, making purchases, and administering contracts. The audience may include: Buyers Contract Specialists Contracting Officers Contracting Officer�s Representatives (CORs) Government Purchase Cardholders and Approving Officials Service Unit Chief Executive Officers Program and technical personnel Albuquerque Area leadership This broad audience provides participating businesses an opportunity to increase awareness of their capabilities across IHS while helping acquisition and program personnel identify potential sources for future requirements. ? Why Participate? The Albuquerque Area IHS is committed to meaningful industry engagement and expanding opportunities for Native American-owned small businesses. Participation in Industry Day provides businesses an opportunity to: Introduce their company directly to IHS acquisition, program, and organizational personnel Increase awareness of their products, services, and capabilities Help IHS identify new and emerging industry capabilities Support IHS market research and acquisition planning Develop relationships with acquisition and program personnel Increase awareness of potential opportunities to do business with IHS At the same time, these interactions help Albuquerque Area IHS broaden its procurement base, identify qualified sources, increase competition, and strengthen relationships with the Native American-owned business community. We want to learn what your business can do for IHS. ? How to Participate Native American-owned small businesses interested in participating should email: ALBAreaSmallBusiness@ihs.gov Please indicate your interest in participating in the 2026 Albuquerque Area IHS Native American-Owned Small Business Industry Day and include your business name and primary point of contact. Upon receipt of your email, the Albuquerque Area IHS will provide a registration form to collect additional business information and assist with scheduling. Presentation times will be scheduled in advance. Each participating vendor will receive 10 minutes to present its capabilities, qualifications, products, and/or services. Space is limited, and registration will close once all available vendor presentation slots have been filled. Vendors are encouraged to register early. Additional event and Microsoft Teams information will be provided to registered participants prior to the event. ? Building Partnerships in Support of the IHS Mission Through the 2026 Albuquerque Area IHS Native American-Owned Small Business Industry Day, DCGM seeks to strengthen relationships with Native American-owned businesses, expand awareness of industry capabilities, broaden the Albuquerque Area procurement base, and identify qualified sources capable of supporting healthcare delivery. These partnerships help ensure that Albuquerque Area IHS acquisition professionals have access to capable and innovative businesses that can provide the supplies, services, equipment, and solutions necessary to support direct patient care and advance the IHS mission: �To raise the physical, mental, social and spiritual health of American Indians and Alaska Natives to the highest level.� ? Join us September 28-29, 2026, and show Albuquerque Area IHS what your business can do! ?? Important Notice This Industry Day is being conducted for informational, outreach, and market research purposes. This event is not a bidder�s conference, solicitation, Request for Proposal, Request for Quote, promise to contract, or commitment by the Government to award a contract. Participation in this event does not guarantee consideration for or award of any future procurement. The Government will not assume liability for costs incurred by any participant associated with attending the event or preparing, submitting, or presenting information, capability statements, presentations, or other materials. Costs incurred in response to this notice will not be considered allowable direct or indirect charges to the Government.

title: Germany – Transformer substation – Neubau 380kV luftisolierte Schaltanlage für den Anschluss von Batteriespeicheranlagen als Generalübernehmer
description: Im Rahmen von Netzanschlussbegehren wurde für den Anschluss von drei Netzpetenten an das 380kV Netz der TransnetBW am Standort PULVE die Umsetzung mehrerer Maßnahmen gefordert. Dazu zählt die Errichtung einer 380kV luftisolierten Schaltanlage der TBW Klasse “Kleinanlage”. Die Schaltanlage besteht aus einer 2-fach Sammelschiene, einer Kupplung und sieben Schaltfeldern. Über diese Schaltfelder sollen die beiden Stromkreise 8045 blau Mühlhausen-Pulverdingen und 8021 rot Großgartach C2 Pulverdingen eingeschleift werden. Hinsichtlich der Bemessungsdaten und des Mengengerüstes für die zukünftigen Anforderungen ist die Erweiterung der bestehenden 380-kV-Schaltanlage nach aktuellem TransnetBW Standard nicht möglich. Daher können die Maßnahmen nur durch den Neubau einer luftisolierten 380-kV-Schaltanlage mit Betriebsgebäude realisiert werden. Hankkeen toteuttaja vuokraa päiväkodin tontin kaupungilta. Vuokrakohde on vuokranantajan rakentama ja omistama lasten päiväkoti. Hankkeen hyötyala on alustavan tilaohjelman mukaisesti n. 2010,5 hym2.
